solutions.title: Buildots + Dot
solutions.summary: Construction progress from site captures, BIM and schedules, with conversational access to structured progress records.
solutions.limitations: Vendor-described workflow. Processing latency is distinct from question-answering latency.

solutions.title: OpenSpace
solutions.summary: Construction visual documentation and progress tracking organized by site location, trade and schedule activity.
solutions.limitations: Official materials describe AI combined with construction-expert review.

solutions.title: DroneDeploy Progress AI
solutions.summary: Progress reports and work-in-place comparisons from 360-degree walks and drone capture.
solutions.limitations: The catalog records early-access language and unmatched timing claims. Availability was not re-audited.

solutions.title: Retrocausal Assembly / Kaizen Copilot
solutions.summary: Camera-based assembly guidance, step traceability, mistake alerts and process analysis.
solutions.limitations: Vendor-described workstation/SOP onboarding differs from mobile construction work.

solutions.title: viAct Smart Helmet / viGENT / viHUB
solutions.summary: Helmet and site-safety signals linked to incident notifications, records and supervisor workflows.
solutions.limitations: The checked page does not establish continuous egocentric video capture. Helmet telemetry and separate camera analytics must be distinguished.

solutions.title: Kiber Assistant / Repogen
solutions.summary: User-directed wearable capture, remote collaboration and reports assembled from voice, images and video.
solutions.limitations: Autonomous defect detection and automatic correction verification were not established.

solutions.title: Verkada Natural-Language Video Search
solutions.summary: Natural-language archive search over indexed person and vehicle observations with camera and time filters.
solutions.limitations: Vendor engineering account. Retrieval does not establish procedural correctness or repair tracking.

solutions.title: NVIDIA Video Search and Summarization
solutions.summary: Reusable video ingestion, search, question answering and incident-verification components for integrators.
solutions.limitations: Reference architecture documented at version 3.3.0 in the source catalog, not a validated construction-specific product.
